title: Delegate intermediate Bússola case decisions to a bounded specialist council
outcome_ref: Produce a publish-ready Bússola public case with no routine intermediate Kell gates and one final publication/merge decision.

governance_profile.notes: Intermediate creative and implementation choices are reversible on a proposal branch. Public publication remains human-controlled.

inputs: explicit owner instruction on 2026-10-11 to let specialists debate and self-regulate until publish-ready
Bússola repository evidence and current case artifacts
criteria: ordinary specialist questions are resolved by the relevant expertise
human escalation occurs only on declared exceptions
final candidate satisfies publish-readiness rubric and quality blockers

authority_required.notes: Kell explicitly delegates reversible intermediate decisions to this bounded council. No publication, merge or canonical authority is delegated.

exception_conditions: unclear publication right, consent or confidentiality

decision.selected_option: bounded specialist deliberation with final-only human publication gate
decision.rationale: The owner wants the team to resolve expertise questions internally and surface the work only when it is ready to publish.

evidence: existing Agentic Factory authority model and first-class decision framework
expected_outcome: The Bússola landing reaches Kell once, as a publish-ready candidate with consolidated evidence and no routine intermediate design approvals.
